cloud.backup_desc: Encrypted backups with AES-256-GCM. Daily DB + weekly file backups, auto-pruned. Your key - we can't read it.
cloud.feature_accounting_desc: Push invoices and contacts to QuickBooks or Xero, with bank reconciliation. No double entry - your books stay current.
cloud.feature_ai_desc: Ask questions about your business in plain English. Inventory analysis, AR summaries, auto-draft purchase orders, invoice reconciliation.
cloud.feature_backup_desc: Your database is automatically backed up and encrypted with a key only you hold. If your machine dies, pull your backup and keep going.
cloud.feature_payments_desc: Invoices get paid faster when they carry a Pay button. Card payments record and reconcile automatically.
cloud.feature_url_desc: Get a permanent address like yourname.celerp.com. Share it with your staff - they open a browser and log in with the permissions you set. No VPN, no port forwarding, no IT setup.
cloud.feature_website_desc: Sync orders, products, and customers from your Shopify and WooCommerce stores - automatically, on a schedule.
cloud.hero_desc1: Check stock from home. Let your staff log in from the shop floor, each with the permissions you set. Celerp keeps running on your machine and your data stays there - Web Access adds a secure URL (like yourname.celerp.com) you can reach from any browser.
cloud.hero_desc2: Your data never leaves your machine. We just relay the connection.
cloud.plan_ai_desc: Everything in Connect, plus an assistant that knows your business.
cloud.trial_sub: A card is required, but nothing is charged for 14 days. Cancel during the trial and pay nothing - we'll email you before it ends.
